name: Poison Tip
description:
Once per day, you may apply poison to the tips of projectiles for your ranged weapons. Roll Craft and record the result.

For the next day, whenever you hit a creature with a poisoned projectile, the creature rolls Fortitude against your earlier Craft roll. On a win, the creature takes -1 Defense. At the beginning of each of its turns, it must repeat the roll. On a win, the take an additional -1 Defense. On a loss, the effect ends.
successes:
✨: Each time the creature takes -1 Defense, it also takes 1d4 damage.

🌞: Each time the creature takes -1 Defense, it also rolls Injury.

💀: The poison is ineffective. Check a Condition.
